34	TRAIN_SOURCES="${TRAIN_SOURCES:-nq,hotpotqa}"
35	TEST_SOURCES="${TEST_SOURCES:-nq,hotpotqa}"
36	
37	DATASET_ONLY="${DATASET_ONLY:-0}"
38	CORPUS_ONLY="${CORPUS_ONLY:-0}"
39	# Re-download even if the target files already exist.
40	FORCE="${FORCE:-0}"
41	
42	if [[ ! -d "$SEARCH_R1_DIR/scripts/data_process" ]]; then
43	  echo "error: Search-R1 data-prep scripts not found under: $SEARCH_R1_DIR" >&2
44	  echo "       set SEARCH_R1_DIR to the trimmed Search-R1 repo." >&2
45	  exit 1
46	fi
47	
48	# The merge scripts import verl.utils.hdfs_io from the repo root.
49	export PYTHONPATH="$SEARCH_R1_DIR${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
50	
51	# --- 1) QA dataset ---------------------------------------------------------
52	prepare_dataset() {
53	  local train_parquet="$DATASET_DIR/train.parquet"
54	  local test_parquet="$DATASET_DIR/test.parquet"
55	
56	  if [[ "$FORCE" != "1" && -f "$train_parquet" && -f "$test_parquet" ]]; then
57	    echo "==> QA parquet already present, skipping ($DATASET_DIR)"
58	    echo "    -> $train_parquet"
59	    echo "    -> $test_parquet"
60	    return
61	  fi
62	
63	  echo "==> Building QA parquet into $DATASET_DIR"
64	  echo "    train sources: $TRAIN_SOURCES"
65	  echo "    test  sources: $TEST_SOURCES"
66	  mkdir -p "$DATASET_DIR"
67	
68	  if [[ "$FORCE" != "1" && -f "$train_parquet" ]]; then
69	    echo "    train.parquet exists, skipping train merge"
70	  else
71	    python "$SEARCH_R1_DIR/scripts/data_process/qa_search_train_merge.py" \
72	      --local_dir "$DATASET_DIR" --data_sources "$TRAIN_SOURCES"
73	  fi
74	
75	  if [[ "$FORCE" != "1" && -f "$test_parquet" ]]; then
76	    echo "    test.parquet exists, skipping test merge"
77	  else
78	    python "$SEARCH_R1_DIR/scripts/data_process/qa_search_test_merge.py" \
79	      --local_dir "$DATASET_DIR" --data_sources "$TEST_SOURCES"

81	
82	  echo "    -> $train_parquet"
83	  echo "    -> $test_parquet"
84	}
85	
86	# --- 2) retrieval corpus (wiki-18 e5) --------------------------------------

91	  if [[ "$FORCE" != "1" && -f "$index" && -f "$jsonl" ]]; then
92	    echo "==> wiki-18 corpus already present, skipping ($CORPUS_DIR)"
93	    echo "    -> $index"
94	    echo "    -> $jsonl"
95	    return
96	  fi
97	
98	  echo "==> Downloading wiki-18 e5 index + corpus into $CORPUS_DIR"
99	  echo "    NOTE: the assembled index is ~130GB; ensure disk + bandwidth."
100	  mkdir -p "$CORPUS_DIR"
101	
102	  # Pulls PeterJinGo/wiki-18-e5-index (part_aa, part_ab) and
103	  # PeterJinGo/wiki-18-corpus (wiki-18.jsonl.gz) from the HuggingFace Hub.
104	  python "$SEARCH_R1_DIR/scripts/download.py" --save_path "$CORPUS_DIR"
105	
106	  echo "    Assembling e5_Flat.index from shards"
107	  cat "$CORPUS_DIR"/part_* > "$index"
108	  rm -f "$CORPUS_DIR"/part_*
109	
110	  if [[ -f "$CORPUS_DIR/wiki-18.jsonl.gz" ]]; then
111	    echo "    Decompressing wiki-18.jsonl"
112	    gzip -df "$CORPUS_DIR/wiki-18.jsonl.gz"
113	  fi
114	
115	  echo "    -> $index"
116	  echo "    -> $jsonl"
117	}
118	
119	# --- run -------------------------------------------------------------------
120	if [[ "$CORPUS_ONLY" == "1" ]]; then
121	  prepare_corpus
122	elif [[ "$DATASET_ONLY" == "1" ]]; then
123	  prepare_dataset
124	else
125	  prepare_dataset
126	  prepare_corpus
127	fi
128	
129	echo "==> Done."

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Prepare the inputs for the Search-R1 slime recipe:
#   1. the QA dataset  -> nq_hotpotqa_train/{train,test}.parquet
#   2. the retrieval corpus -> wiki-18 e5 FAISS index + wiki-18.jsonl
#
# It drives the data-preparation subset of the Search-R1 repo that ships next to
# this recipe (workspace/Search-R1). Nothing here trains a model.
#
# Usage:
#   bash prepare_data.sh                 # dataset + corpus
#   DATASET_ONLY=1 bash prepare_data.sh  # skip the ~130GB corpus download
#   CORPUS_ONLY=1  bash prepare_data.sh  # only the retrieval corpus
#
# Override any path via the environment variables below.
set -euo pipefail

# --- locations -------------------------------------------------------------
# Directory of this script (examples/search-r1), resolved so it works from any cwd.
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

# The trimmed Search-R1 repo. Defaults to the copy staged in this workspace
# (workspace/Search-R1); at container runtime the recipe reads /root/Search-R1,
# so allow an override.
SEARCH_R1_DIR="${SEARCH_R1_DIR:-$(cd "$HERE/../../Search-R1" && pwd)}"

# Where prepared assets land. Keep them inside the repo's data/ dir so the paths
# match the recipe's --prompt-data (…/Search-R1/data/nq_hotpotqa_train/…).
DATA_DIR="${DATA_DIR:-$PWD}"
DATASET_DIR="${DATASET_DIR:-$DATA_DIR/nq_hotpotqa_train}"
CORPUS_DIR="${CORPUS_DIR:-$DATA_DIR/wiki-18}"

# Which QA sources to merge. Train mixes NQ+HotpotQA (the recipe default); the
# test merge can span more sets for evaluation.
TRAIN_SOURCES="${TRAIN_SOURCES:-nq,hotpotqa}"
TEST_SOURCES="${TEST_SOURCES:-nq,hotpotqa}"

DATASET_ONLY="${DATASET_ONLY:-0}"
CORPUS_ONLY="${CORPUS_ONLY:-0}"
# Re-download even if the target files already exist.
FORCE="${FORCE:-0}"

if [[ ! -d "$SEARCH_R1_DIR/scripts/data_process" ]]; then
  echo "error: Search-R1 data-prep scripts not found under: $SEARCH_R1_DIR" >&2
  echo "       set SEARCH_R1_DIR to the trimmed Search-R1 repo." >&2
  exit 1
fi

# The merge scripts import verl.utils.hdfs_io from the repo root.
export PYTHONPATH="$SEARCH_R1_DIR${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"

# --- 1) QA dataset ---------------------------------------------------------
prepare_dataset() {
  local train_parquet="$DATASET_DIR/train.parquet"
  local test_parquet="$DATASET_DIR/test.parquet"

  if [[ "$FORCE" != "1" && -f "$train_parquet" && -f "$test_parquet" ]]; then
    echo "==> QA parquet already present, skipping ($DATASET_DIR)"
    echo "    -> $train_parquet"
    echo "    -> $test_parquet"
    return
  fi

  echo "==> Building QA parquet into $DATASET_DIR"
  echo "    train sources: $TRAIN_SOURCES"
  echo "    test  sources: $TEST_SOURCES"
  mkdir -p "$DATASET_DIR"

  if [[ "$FORCE" != "1" && -f "$train_parquet" ]]; then
    echo "    train.parquet exists, skipping train merge"
  else
    python "$SEARCH_R1_DIR/scripts/data_process/qa_search_train_merge.py" \
      --local_dir "$DATASET_DIR" --data_sources "$TRAIN_SOURCES"
  fi

  if [[ "$FORCE" != "1" && -f "$test_parquet" ]]; then
    echo "    test.parquet exists, skipping test merge"
  else
    python "$SEARCH_R1_DIR/scripts/data_process/qa_search_test_merge.py" \
      --local_dir "$DATASET_DIR" --data_sources "$TEST_SOURCES"
  fi

  echo "    -> $train_parquet"
  echo "    -> $test_parquet"
}

# --- 2) retrieval corpus (wiki-18 e5) --------------------------------------
prepare_corpus() {
  local index="$CORPUS_DIR/e5_Flat.index"
  local jsonl="$CORPUS_DIR/wiki-18.jsonl"

  if [[ "$FORCE" != "1" && -f "$index" && -f "$jsonl" ]]; then
    echo "==> wiki-18 corpus already present, skipping ($CORPUS_DIR)"
    echo "    -> $index"
    echo "    -> $jsonl"
    return
  fi

  echo "==> Downloading wiki-18 e5 index + corpus into $CORPUS_DIR"
  echo "    NOTE: the assembled index is ~130GB; ensure disk + bandwidth."
  mkdir -p "$CORPUS_DIR"

  # Pulls PeterJinGo/wiki-18-e5-index (part_aa, part_ab) and
  # PeterJinGo/wiki-18-corpus (wiki-18.jsonl.gz) from the HuggingFace Hub.
  python "$SEARCH_R1_DIR/scripts/download.py" --save_path "$CORPUS_DIR"

  echo "    Assembling e5_Flat.index from shards"
  cat "$CORPUS_DIR"/part_* > "$index"
  rm -f "$CORPUS_DIR"/part_*

  if [[ -f "$CORPUS_DIR/wiki-18.jsonl.gz" ]]; then
    echo "    Decompressing wiki-18.jsonl"
    gzip -df "$CORPUS_DIR/wiki-18.jsonl.gz"
  fi

  echo "    -> $index"
  echo "    -> $jsonl"
}

# --- run -------------------------------------------------------------------
if [[ "$CORPUS_ONLY" == "1" ]]; then
  prepare_corpus
elif [[ "$DATASET_ONLY" == "1" ]]; then
  prepare_dataset
else
  prepare_dataset
  prepare_corpus
fi

echo "==> Done."

        self._pg = pg
        self._num_gpus_per_actor = num_gpus_per_actor
        self.role = role
        self._actor_cls = actor_cls
        self._with_ref = with_ref
        self._with_opd_teacher = with_opd_teacher
        self._rollout_manager = None
        self._disk_weight_version = getattr(args, "update_weight_start_version", 0)
        self._actor_handlers = []

    def _allocate_gpus_for_actor(self, pg, num_gpus_per_actor):
        world_size = self._num_nodes * self._num_gpus_per_node

        # Use placement group to lock resources for models of same type
        assert pg is not None
        pg, reordered_bundle_indices, _reordered_gpu_ids = pg

        env_vars = {
            # because sglang will always set NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE to 0
            # we need also set it to 0 to prevent nccl error.
            "NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE": os.environ.get("NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE", "0"),
            "NVTE_FP8_BLOCK_SCALING_FP32_SCALES": os.environ.get("NVTE_FP8_BLOCK_SCALING_FP32_SCALES", "1"),
            **{name: "1" for name in NOSET_VISIBLE_DEVICES_ENV_VARS_LIST},
            **self.args.train_env_vars,
        }

        if self.args.offload_train and self.args.train_backend == "megatron":
            env_vars.update(memory_saver_preload_env(enable_from_start=True))

        # We cannot do routing replay for critic.
        if self.args.use_routing_replay and self.role == "actor":
            env_vars["ENABLE_ROUTING_REPLAY"] = "1"

        if self._actor_cls is None:
            from slime.backends.megatron_utils.actor import MegatronTrainRayActor

            actor_impl = MegatronTrainRayActor
        else:
            actor_impl = self._actor_cls

        actor_options = {
            "num_gpus": 1,
            "runtime_env": {"env_vars": add_default_ray_env_vars(env_vars)},
        }
        if getattr(self.args, "rollout_data_transport", "object-store") == "nixl":
            actor_options["enable_tensor_transport"] = True
        TrainRayActor = ray.remote(**actor_options)(actor_impl)

        # Create worker actors
        self._actor_handlers = []
        master_addr, master_port = None, None
        for rank in range(world_size):
            actor = TrainRayActor.options(
                num_cpus=num_gpus_per_actor,
                num_gpus=num_gpus_per_actor,
                scheduling_strategy=PlacementGroupSchedulingStrategy(
                    placement_group=pg,
                    placement_group_bundle_index=reordered_bundle_indices[rank],
                ),
            ).remote(world_size, rank, master_addr, master_port)
            if rank == 0:
                master_addr, master_port = ray.get(actor.get_master_addr_and_port.remote())
            self._actor_handlers.append(actor)

    def async_train(self, rollout_id, rollout_data_ref, external_data=None):
        """Do one rollout training. Returns a list of Ray refs (one per worker).

        For critics, each ref resolves to ``{"values": [cpu tensors...]}`` (or ``{}``
        for non-last-PP-stage workers). Actor refs resolve to ``None``.

        ``external_data`` may be a list (one item per worker) or a single dict
        broadcast to all workers.
        """
        if isinstance(external_data, list):
            assert len(external_data) == len(self._actor_handlers)
            return [
                actor.train.remote(rollout_id, rollout_data_ref, external_data=ed)
                for actor, ed in zip(self._actor_handlers, external_data, strict=False)
            ]
        return [
            actor.train.remote(rollout_id, rollout_data_ref, external_data=external_data)
            for actor in self._actor_handlers
        ]

    def save_model(self, rollout_id, force_sync=False):
        """Save actor model"""
        ret = ray.get([actor.save_model.remote(rollout_id, force_sync=force_sync) for actor in self._actor_handlers])
        if self._release_train_enabled():
            self.args.load = self.args.save
            self.args.ckpt_step = None
            self.args.finetune = False
            self.args.no_load_optim = self.args.no_save_optim
            self.args.no_load_rng = False
        return ret

    def update_weights(self):
        """Broadcast weights from rank 0 to all other ranks."""
        if not self._full_disk_weight_update_enabled():
            return ray.get([actor.update_weights.remote() for actor in self._actor_handlers])

        weight_version = self._disk_weight_version + 1
        disk_weight_dir = Path(self.args.update_weight_disk_dir) / f"weight_v{weight_version:06d}"
        ray.get([actor.update_weights.remote() for actor in self._actor_handlers])
        self._disk_weight_version = weight_version

# Adapted from https://github.com/OpenRLHF/OpenRLHF/blob/10c733694ed9fbb78a0a2ff6a05efc7401584d46/openrlhf/trainer/ray/utils.py#L1
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import ray
import torch
from slime.ray.ray_actor import RayActor

# Refer to
# https://github.com/ray-project/ray/blob/161849364a784442cc659fb9780f1a6adee85fce/python/ray/_private/accelerators/nvidia_gpu.py#L95-L96
# https://github.com/ray-project/ray/blob/161849364a784442cc659fb9780f1a6adee85fce/python/ray/_private/accelerators/amd_gpu.py#L102-L103
# https://github.com/ray-project/ray/blob/161849364a784442cc659fb9780f1a6adee85fce/python/ray/_private/accelerators/npu.py#L94-L95
# https://github.com/ray-project/ray/blob/161849364a784442cc659fb9780f1a6adee85fce/python/ray/_private/accelerators/hpu.py#L116-L117
# https://github.com/ray-project/ray/blob/161849364a784442cc659fb9780f1a6adee85fce/python/ray/_private/accelerators/neuron.py#L108-L109
# https://github.com/ray-project/ray/blob/161849364a784442cc659fb9780f1a6adee85fce/python/ray/_private/accelerators/tpu.py#L171-L172
# https://github.com/ray-project/ray/blob/161849364a784442cc659fb9780f1a6adee85fce/python/ray/_private/accelerators/intel_gpu.py#L97-L98
NOSET_VISIBLE_DEVICES_ENV_VARS_LIST = [
    "RAY_EXPERIMENTAL_NOSET_CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES",
    "RAY_EXPERIMENTAL_NOSET_ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES",
    "RAY_EXPERIMENTAL_NOSET_ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES",
    "RAY_EXPERIMENTAL_NOSET_HABANA_VISIBLE_MODULES",
    "RAY_EXPERIMENTAL_NOSET_NEURON_RT_VISIBLE_CORES",
    "RAY_EXPERIMENTAL_NOSET_TPU_VISIBLE_CHIPS",
    "RAY_EXPERIMENTAL_NOSET_ONEAPI_DEVICE_SELECTOR",
]

RAY_DEFAULT_ENV_VARS = {
    # Ray's uvloop integration has caused intermittent async actor issues.
    "RAY_USE_UVLOOP": "0",
    # Let sglang's JIT loader (load_jit) find slime-hosted custom kernel .cuh
    # sources (e.g. glm5_router_gemm) and try-cache compile them, so they need
    # not be patched into the sglang source tree.
    "SGLANG_JIT_KERNEL_EXTRA_PATH": os.path.join(
        os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))),
        "backends",
        "sglang_utils",
        "jit_kernels",
    ),
}


def add_default_ray_env_vars(env_vars: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> dict[str, str]:
    return RAY_DEFAULT_ENV_VARS | (env_vars or {})


def memory_saver_loader_env() -> dict[str, str]:
    """Conda/pip stand-in for the official image's /usr/local/cuda/lib64.

    Official slime:latest puts system CUDA on LD_LIBRARY_PATH via image ENV.
    This stack keeps libcudart under site-packages/nvidia/*/lib. SGLang's
    configure_subprocess() only sets LD_PRELOAD; the preload .so still needs
    these dirs in the scheduler process or it will not load.
    """
    nvidia = (
        Path(sys.prefix)
        / "lib"
        / f"python{sys.version_info.major}.{sys.version_info.minor}"
        / "site-packages"
        / "nvidia"
    )
    extras = [str(p) for p in (*nvidia.glob("*/lib"), *nvidia.glob("*/lib64"))]
    extras.append(str(Path(sys.prefix) / "lib"))
    merged: list[str] = []
    for part in (*os.environ.get("LD_LIBRARY_PATH", "").split(":"), *extras):
        if part and part not in merged:
            merged.append(part)
    return {"LD_LIBRARY_PATH": ":".join(merged)}


def _preload_dynlib() -> Path:
    import torch_memory_saver

    parent = Path(torch_memory_saver.__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    pkg = Path(torch_memory_saver.__file__).resolve().parent

import ast
import asyncio
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
module_path = Path('/workspace/examples/search-r1/generate_with_search.py')
tree = ast.parse(module_path.read_text())
selected = [n for n in tree.body if (
    isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == 'SEARCH_R1_CONFIGS' for t in n.targets)
) or (
    isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and n.name in {'_passages2string', 'reward_func'}
)]
ns = {}
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=selected, type_ignores=[]), str(module_path), 'exec'), ns)
rendered = ns['_passages2string']([{'document': {'contents': 'Paris\nParis is the capital of France.'}}])
assert 'Paris is the capital of France.' in rendered, rendered

scorer_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('staged_qa_em_format', '/workspace/examples/search-r1/qa_em_format.py')
scorer = importlib.util.module_from_spec(scorer_spec)
scorer_spec.loader.exec_module(scorer)
ns['compute_score_em'] = scorer.compute_score_em
class Sample: pass
ns['Sample'] = Sample
prompt = '<|im_start|>user\nFor example, <answer> Beijing </answer>.<|im_end|>\n<|im_start|>assistant\n'
def score(response, target):
    sample = Sample()
    sample.prompt = prompt
    sample.response = response
    sample.label = {'ground_truth': {'target': [target]}}
    return asyncio.run(ns['reward_func'](None, sample))

assert score('<answer>Paris</answer>', 'Paris') == 0.8
print('passage body: preserved')
print('reward shaping: valid wrong=0.2, valid correct=1.0, unformatted correct=0.8')

arguments.content:
# Diagnosis and repair report

## 1. Verdict — unhealthy

The frozen run completes and produces finite metrics, but its held-out behavior is unhealthy. `outputs/metrics.json`, `historical_evidence/eval_scores.json`, and `wandb/offline-run-20261104_151358-tk7nj5n8/files/output.log` agree on the following trajectory:

| Step | `eval/nq_test` | Eval mean response tokens | Eval truncated ratio | Train `rollout/raw_reward` | Train mean response tokens |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0 | 0.033000 | 932.777 | 0.363667 | 0.035156 | 1038.020 |
| 19 | 0.104000 | 84.248 | 0.021667 | 0.140625 | 72.629 |
| 49 | 0.136333 | 11.953 | 0.001000 | 0.179688 | 8.941 |
| 99 | 0.153333 | 11.779 | 0.001333 | 0.171875 | 9.520 |
| 199 | 0.167333 | 12.226 | 0.000667 | 0.167969 | 9.152 |

The held-out score plateaus around 0.15–0.17 (historical maximum 0.168333 at step 179), while evaluation and training responses collapse to approximately 10–12 tokens. The falling truncation ratio is therefore not evidence of recovery: it accompanies abandonment of substantive multi-turn responses. Training raw reward increases, but it tracks the same low-scoring degenerate policy and does not establish held-out health. The historical receipt reports a successful run and first rollout, so this is not explained by a startup crash or an absent first rollout.

## 2. Root cause

Two coupled defects in `examples/search-r1/generate_with_search.py` explain the observed behavior.

### Retrieval observations discard every passage body

`_passages2string` split each returned document into `title` and `text`, but appended only the title:

```python
format_reference += f"Doc {idx+1}(Title: {title})\n"
```

The local retrieval server returns full document `contents`, and `local_search_server.py` preserves those contents. The staged reference formatter at `Search-R1/scripts/data_process/nq_rag.py:44-52` also includes `{text}`. Thus the defect was in the rollout formatter, not the retrieval server or dataset: the model received headings without the evidence needed to answer its query. This makes learning useful search behavior difficult and is consistent with the low held-out ceiling.

### The configured format reward is connected to an unused scorer argument

`reward_func` passed `format_score=SEARCH_R1_CONFIGS["format_score"]`. In the protected `qa_em_format.py`, `format_score` is accepted but never used; the operative argument is `structure_format_score`. Consequently, the configured 0.2 structured-format reward had no effect.

A local synthetic check against the unmodified protected scorer demonstrated the incentive:

- Validly formatted wrong answer: old call returned **0**, versus **0.2** with `structure_format_score=0.2`.
- Validly formatted correct answer: **1.0** either way.
- Unformatted direct correct answer: old call returned **1.0**, versus **0.8** with the structured format penalty enabled.

The old wiring therefore gave short direct guesses the maximum reward while giving formatted exploratory trajectories no partial credit when their answer was wrong. This directly supports the observed rapid transition from long search trajectories to approximately 10-token responses. Restoring passage bodies supplies useful evidence, and restoring the intended format shaping removes the reward advantage of the degenerate direct-answer policy.

## 3. Changes

### `examples/search-r1/generate_with_search.py`

- Changed `_passages2string` to append `{text}` after each document title, preserving the retrieved passage body in `<information>` observations.
- Changed `reward_func` to pass the configured value as `structure_format_score`, matching the protected scorer's actual API. The required custom reward path remains `generate_with_search.reward_func`.

### `examples/search-r1/run_qwen2.5_3B.sh`

- Changed `--num-rollout` from 200 to the required **100**.
- Entered the repository root before launch and changed the default model/data roots to literal `/workspace`. The resulting defaults are:
  - HF checkpoint `/workspace/Qwen2.5-3B`
  - Megatron reference `/workspace/Qwen2.5-3B_torch_dist`
  - Train data `/workspace/nq_hotpotqa_train/train.parquet`
  - Validation data `/workspace/nq_hotpotqa_train/test.parquet`
- Retained the existing conditional HF-to-`torch_dist` conversion. Since the converted directory is currently absent, the rerun will create the required reference at that exact path before submitting training.
- Added `LOG_DIR` handling with a `$AUTORLBENCH_RESULTS/experiment_logs` fallback. The training job's combined stdout/stderr is now written to `$LOG_DIR/train.log` through `tee`; `pipefail` preserves job failure status.
- Set `WANDB_DIR=$LOG_DIR/wandb`, passed `--wandb-mode` and `--wandb-dir` explicitly, and propagated both variables in the Ray runtime environment. This avoids relying on the caller's `WANDB_DIR`, which the old runtime environment did not forward.
- Kept the quoted offline-safe `--wandb-key "${WANDB_API_KEY:-EMPTY}"` behavior.
- Preserved the mandated custom paths, local retrieval URL, `nq_test` evaluation over `test.parquet@[0:3000]`, `--eval-interval 10`, and `--n-samples-per-eval-prompt 1`.

### `report.md`

- Created this diagnosis and repair report.

No protected scorer, retrieval-server, or dataset file was modified. No training, Ray cluster, or retrieval server was launched during diagnosis.

## 4. Expected effect

- **Primary metric:** `eval/nq_test` should **increase** relative to the unhealthy trajectory at comparable rollout steps, because answers can use retrieved passage contents and training no longer maximally rewards unformatted direct guesses.
- **Behavioral metrics:** `eval/nq_test/response_len/mean` and `rollout/response_len/mean` should **increase from the collapsed approximately 10–12-token regime**, reflecting retained reasoning/search trajectories rather than immediate short guesses. Length is a diagnostic here, not an objective to maximize.
- `rollout/raw_reward` may also change because structured format credit is now actually applied, but that shaped reward is not being treated as proof of held-out improvement.
- Truncation should be interpreted jointly with response content and held-out score; a near-zero truncation ratio produced by degenerate short answers is not a desired outcome.

| Step | `eval/nq_test` | Eval mean response tokens | Eval truncated ratio | Train `rollout/raw_reward` | Train mean response tokens |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0 | 0.033000 | 932.777 | 0.363667 | 0.035156 | 1038.020 |
| 19 | 0.104000 | 84.248 | 0.021667 | 0.140625 | 72.629 |
| 49 | 0.136333 | 11.953 | 0.001000 | 0.179688 | 8.941 |
| 99 | 0.153333 | 11.779 | 0.001333 | 0.171875 | 9.520 |
| 199 | 0.167333 | 12.226 | 0.000667 | 0.167969 | 9.152 |

The held-out score plateaus around 0.15–0.17 (historical maximum 0.168333 at step 179), while evaluation and training responses collapse to approximately 10–12 tokens. The falling truncation ratio is therefore not evidence of recovery: it accompanies abandonment of substantive multi-turn responses. Training raw reward increases, but it tracks the same low-scoring degenerate policy and does not establish held-out health. The historical receipt reports a successful run and first rollout, so this is not explained by a startup crash or an absent first rollout.

## 2. Root cause

Two coupled defects in `examples/search-r1/generate_with_search.py` explain the observed behavior.

### Retrieval observations discard every passage body

`_passages2string` split each returned document into `title` and `text`, but appended only the title:

```python
format_reference += f"Doc {idx+1}(Title: {title})\n"
```

The local retrieval server returns full document `contents`, and `local_search_server.py` preserves those contents. The staged reference formatter at `Search-R1/scripts/data_process/nq_rag.py:44-52` also includes `{text}`. Thus the defect was in the rollout formatter, not the retrieval server or dataset: the model received headings without the evidence needed to answer its query. - Validly formatted correct answer: **1.0** either way.
- Unformatted direct correct answer: old call returned **1.0**, versus **0.8** with the structured format penalty enabled.
